verdict_text: NO. The merge arithmetic is wrong: the script computes `tmp = b + λ(f1 - b)` and then `out = tmp + λ(f2 - tmp)`, taking the second task vector against the already-merged tensor instead of the unmodified base. That yields `b + λ(f1-b) + λ(f2-b) - λ²(f1-b)`, which differs from the required `base + λ(ft1-base) + λ(ft2-base)` in Required result step 2 by a `λ²(ft1-base)` term. This is exactly the ordering hazard the specification warns about, and the error will exceed the 1e-5 relative Frobenius tolerance wherever ft1 differs from base. The verification, count checks, and output layout are otherwise fine.
expected_defect: Task vector 2 is computed against the base after task vector 1 has already been added, so the second delta is taken from the wrong reference point.
